description:
What is This Part?
This is a ZIP Fuel Filter for the Suzuki Samurai 1985-1990
This filter mounts in-line just beyond the tank on the out-flow line
Comes with Required Hose Clips!
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Fuel Filter
Qty 2 – Hose Clips
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1990 All Models
